## 报道摘要 | Report summary

**中文。** AP 经 Arab News 报道，苏丹与波兰联合考古队在旧栋古拉的 Great Church of Jesus 楼梯区域到达原始地面。建筑仍有相当部分埋藏；这不是整座教堂已经发掘完成的消息。

**English.** AP, carried by Arab News, reports that the Sudanese–Polish mission reached the original floor in the staircase area of the Great Church of Jesus at Old Dongola. Much of the building remains buried; the report does not describe a completed excavation.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 报道标示 2026-11-16 21:34。教堂发现于 2021 年，到达地面的工作被报道为本月较早时候进行，未提供确切日期；2026-11-09 已有 Archaeology Magazine 报道。

**English.** The report displays 2026-11-16 at 21:34. The church was found in 2021; reaching the floor is placed earlier this month without an exact day. Archaeology Magazine had already covered the work on 2026-11-09.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 本期新增的是报道链接，不宣称这两天首次发现教堂或首次公布地面。关于建筑规模与类比的说法属于研究者解释；本页不采用“最大”等尚未独立比较的判断。

**English.** The new addition is a reporting link, not a claim that the church or floor was first discovered or announced in these two days. Architectural comparisons are attributed interpretations; unverified largest-building claims are not adopted.
